mapper.select: select id, formula_id, herb_name, dosage, unit, sort_order, notes, herb_dict_id from tcm_formula_item where formula_id = #{formulaId} order by sort_order asc
mapper.insert: insert into tcm_formula_item (formula_id, herb_name, dosage, unit, sort_order, notes, herb_dict_id) values (#{formulaId}, #{herbName}, #{dosage}, #{unit}, #{sortOrder}, #{notes}, #{herbDictId})
